criteria.label: Ramp Access
criteria.description: A ramp is present at the entrance if steps exist.

criteria.label: Step-Free Entrance
criteria.description: The main entrance is completely step-free and ground level.

criteria.label: Wide Doorways
criteria.description: Doorways are wide enough for wheelchair access.

criteria.label: Tactile Paving
criteria.description: Tactile guidance paths or warning surfaces are visible on the floor/ground.

criteria.label: Accessible Restroom
criteria.description: An accessible restroom is visible (indicated by signage, grab bars, etc.).

criteria.label: Clear Pathways
criteria.description: Corridors and pathways are clear of obstacles and wide enough for navigation.

criteria.label: Braille/Tactile Signage
criteria.description: Signs include Braille or tactile characters for the visually impaired.
